Travel without Borders – Planning Bespoke Holidays to Germany

Welcome to Travel without Borders – an experienced travel planner specialising in tailor-made and special interest holidays to Germany- for independent travellers and private groups.

Learn More

Berlin – Major Cities

Germany's vibrant capital — history, culture and landmark architecture.

Augsburg – Bavaria

One of Germany's oldest cities, full of Renaissance splendour.

Neuschwanstein – Bavaria

The fairytale castle that inspired Disney — magical under a blanket of alpine snow.

Berchtesgadener Land – Bavaria

Alpine lakes and pilgrimage churches beneath Bavaria's highest peaks.

Bamberg – Bavaria

A UNESCO World Heritage old town on the river in Franconian Bavaria.

Heidelberg – Black Forest

Romantic castle ruins above the Neckar in one of Germany's loveliest towns.

The Black Forest

Deep pine woods, cuckoo clocks and the famous Black Forest cherry gateau.

Zell-Mosel – Rhine, Mosel & Eifel

A vineyard-clad riverside town on the winding Mosel.

Trier – Rhine, Mosel & Eifel

Germany's oldest city, founded by the Romans on the Mosel.

Dresden – Major Cities

Baroque splendour on the Elbe — palaces, domes and floodlit riverside terraces.

Hamburg – Major Cities

A grand maritime city of waterways, the town hall and Lake Alster.

Bastei Bridge – Eastern Germany

Dramatic sandstone pinnacles and bridge in Saxon Switzerland.

Colditz Castle – Special Interest

The legendary WWII escape-proof castle in Saxony.

Football Camps – Special Interest

Bespoke football training camps in the heart of Bavaria.

From inspiration and itinerary design to practical advice and logistics, we help you create a personalised holiday that reflects your interests and makes the most of your time in Germany.

Are you looking for a sightseeing tour through a historic town in breathtaking Bavaria, or perhaps an exploration of the mystical Black Forest? Maybe you would like to experience one of Germany’s famous Christmas Market, discover hidden gems off the beaten track, enjoy food and wine along the picturesque Mosel, or explore the fascinating history of Colditz Castle.

Whatever your interests, we can help you shape a tailor-made itinerary with the flexibility to experience Germany in your own way.

Using our experience and specialist knowledge of Germany, we can help you identify suitable accommodation and transport options, piece together more complex journeys and recommend experiences such as local guides, wine tastings and excursions. Our personal and flexible planning service can save you valuable research time while helping you make informed choices for your trip.

Once your itinerary has been agreed, you make your travel arrangements directly with the relevant providers.

Explore our website and discover the magic of Germany.

In addition, our special interest holidays offer another way to discover Germany – holidays with a ‘twist’.

Germany

A wonderfully diverse destination. From major cities to picturesque holiday resorts, there is an abundance to see and do. Historic towns, inspiring architecture, unspoilt landscapes, idyllic lakes and rivers – Germany really does have it all. Couple this with the exceptional standard of accommodation (from hotels to self-catering apartments) and the wealth of travel options, you will discover that Germany really is worth a visit.

Wide choice of destinations

Bavaria

Exhilarating alpine scenery, vast forests, fairy tale castles, miraculously preserved medieval cities and international centres of culture…

The Black Forest

To the west of Bavaria lies the state of Baden-Württemberg, home of the Black Forest, a vast, unspoilt area of pine woods, mountains, lakes – and glorious fresh air…
